method: Manual pixel picks of black reactor-temperature line after inspecting rendered original. Coordinates use 1290x1700 image. Left axis: (174,358)=0min/260C; right/top (539,134)=40min/340C. Gray line is conversion, not temperature. Step set to5min.
resolution: Deliberately conservative +/-1K independent vertical digitization perturbations. Not sensor measurement uncertainty or new raw experimental data.
